temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl appears stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had no specific prior belief that Cheryl was struggling; she likely viewed Cheryl as a colleague involved in the outreach project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns Cheryl is currently overwhelmed but open to assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl needs help with the project and that Maria can usefully assist her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, compassion, and willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing more confident. During a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase; Cheryl thanks Maria and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved in handling responsibilities and is gaining confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/validated: Maria's suggestion is accepted, and Cheryl explicitly says she is ready and appreciates Maria's confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready and willing to lead the next phase and that her confidence in Cheryl is warranted.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl tells Maria she was a bit surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that suggesting Cheryl for leadership may have overstepped and could cause hard feelings or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns Cheryl was surprised but values the support and does not appear upset.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl felt supported rather than pressured and values Maria's confidence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and to maintain clear, positive communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl agrees enthusiastically to co-lead the project, saying Maria's guidance is invaluable and that they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support; she believes continued collaboration could be beneficial.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/reinforced: Cheryl welcomes co-leading and values Maria's guidance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes she and Cheryl can co-lead effectively and support each other as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After successful collaborations, Cheryl says she would love to team up for more future projects and that working with Maria has been wonderful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership is strong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Reinforced: Cheryl confirms she wants more collaboration and values their working relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes they have a strong, synergistic partnership with good future potential.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future.
